detailMarkdown:
# Claude Code Source Fact Verification Capability Pack Skill

Expert Claude Code skill capability pack for source-grounded fact verification before agents edit code, documentation, prompts, or operational instructions.

## Trust
- Source: source-backed
- Package: maintainer-built/verified package
- Review: unclaimed

## Safety notes
- Verification may run read-only shell commands such as git, package-manager metadata, test discovery, or file searches; confirm before running expensive or networked checks.
- Do not convert unverified assumptions into code changes, migrations, security claims, or README statements.
- If sources conflict, stop and report the contradiction instead of forcing a synthesized answer.

## Privacy notes
- Repository source, issues, logs, package manifests, and documentation snippets may be used as evidence in the agent context.
- Avoid pasting secrets, customer data, private incident details, or proprietary logs into external search or third-party documentation tools.
- Record source URLs and local file paths, but redact tokens, credentials, and sensitive identifiers from final reports.

## Install
```bash
curl -L https://heyclau.de/downloads/skills/claude-code-source-fact-verification-capability-pack.zip -o claude-code-source-fact-verification-capability-pack.zip && unzip -o claude-code-source-fact-verification-capability-pack.zip -d ./claude-code-source-fact-verification-capability-pack
```

## Usage
Use this skill when a Claude Code task depends on current APIs, product behavior, security rules, migration guides, changelogs, or claims that must be traceable.
